outside_window.finding: Core has an open offtake process 'to assess proposals and strategic options regarding offtake, exploring ways to leverage an unencumbered offtake position', stated in the June quarterly. No outcome or timing has been announced, so a binding offtake or prepayment is a live positive catalyst with no date. Nothing links it to the annual report.

The first shipment of newly produced spodumene concentrate is targeted for the December quarter 2026, per the 2026-09-08 first-concentrate announcement. The plant is still in commissioning and optimisation, so the ramp risk resolves in the September quarterly report (late October) and not in the annual report.
